clips.title: The story
paras: Beneath the ruins of Lordaeron, Apothecary Zinge works for the Forsaken. She studies biological specimens and arranges research shipments across Horde lands.

Apothecary Zinge works in the Apothecarium beneath the Undercity. Under Master Apothecary Faranell, she searches for chemical and biological compounds that can advance the Forsaken's aims. Her work connects her with field researchers and scouts far beyond Tirisfal Glades, including at distant outposts in Kalimdor.

Apothecary Zinge depends on couriers and adventurers to carry test materials across the sea. She regularly writes to Apothecary Helbrim at the Crossroads in the Barrens. She sends him toxic wolf heart samples from Silverpine Forest so he can study how Lordaeron's toxins affect Kalimdor's beasts.
